_readme: Machine-readable validation anchors, derived from docs/research/validation-anchors-2026-08-03.md (see it for provenance, tolerances, and caveats).
Scored by validation/score.mjs. Each series: quantity is one of cd | cpPctL | cpOverL | cnaPerRad | cnaPerDeg.
cd series carry base: 'included' (compare kernel total CD) or 'excluded' (compare kernel total minus base CD) to match each dataset's accounting.
tol is absolute in the anchor's unit; relTol is relative (fraction of the anchor value); gate=false series are informational (reported, never counted).
gateMinMach/gateMaxMach restrict which points count toward the gate; outside points report as info.
refAreaScale converts kernel-referenced coefficients (max body diameter area) to the dataset's reference area (kernel value x scale).

KNOWN LIMITATION (v1): the kernel sweep computes Reynolds number at ISA sea level; the tunnels ran fixed Re/ft (ARCAS 3.0e6/ft, Cajun 2.0e6/ft) and RASAero's curves are Re-matched via its Mach-Alt table. Expect a friction-CD bias, worst subsonic. Re-matching is a planned harness upgrade.

arcas-short._machAltNote: RASAero's own tunnel-Re-matching Mach-Alt table for the ARCAS comparison (comparison doc p.9, ft converted to m) - pins sweep Re to the Langley tunnels' 3.0e6/ft.

basic-finner._aoaNote: DREV free-flight coefficients are linear fits over finite yaw (Table VII mean-squared yaw 1-25 deg^2); scoring the sweep at alpha=2 deg matches the fit condition and samples the kernel's alpha-dependent crossflow terms, which a pure alpha->0 slope misses.
